an8.54:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā koliyesu viharati kakkarapattaṃ nāma koliyānaṃ nigamo.
an8.54:1.2: tatra kho dīghajāṇu koliyaputto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho dīghajāṇu koliyaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an8.54:1.3: mayaṃ bhante, gihī kāmabhogī puttasambādhasayanaṃ ajjhāvasāma, kāsikacandanaṃ paccanubhoma, mālāgandhavilepanaṃ dhārayāma, jātarūparajataṃ sādiyāma.
an8.54:1.4: tesaṃ no bhante, bhagavā tathā dhammaṃ desetu, ye amhākaṃ assu dhammā diṭṭhadhammahitāya diṭṭhadhammasukhāya samparāya hitāya samparāyasukhāyāti.
an8.54:2.1: cattāro me vyagghapajja, dhammā kulaputtassa diṭṭhadhammahitāya saṃvattanti diṭṭhadhammasukhāya.
an8.54:2.5: idha vyagghapajja kulaputto yena kammaṭṭhānena jīvikaṃ kappeti,
an8.54:2.6: yadi kasiyā yadi vaṇijjāya yadi gorakkhena yadi issatthena yadi rājaporisena yadi sippaññatarena.
an8.54:2.7: tattha dakkho hoti analaso tatrūpāyāya vīmaṃsāya samannāgato alaṃ kātuṃ alaṃ saṃvidhātuṃ,
an8.54:3.2: idha vyagghapajja, kulaputtassa bhogā honti uṭṭhānaviriyādhigatā bāhābalaparicitā sedāvakkhittā dhammikā dhammaladdhā,
an8.54:3.4: ‘kinti me ime bhoge neva rājāno hareyyuṃ na corā hareyyuṃ na aggi ḍaheyya na udakaṃ vaheyya na appiyā dāyādā hareyyunti.
an8.54:4.2: idha vyagghapajja, kulaputto yasmiṃ gāme vā nigame vā paṭivasati. tattha ye te honti gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā daharā vā vuddhasīlino vuddhā vā vuddhasīlā saddhāsampannā sīlasampannā cāgasampannā paññāsampannā’ tehi saddhiṃ santiṭṭhati sallapati sākacchaṃ samāpajjati. yathā rūpānaṃ saddhāsampannānaṃ saddhāsampadaṃ anusikkhati, yathārūpānaṃ sīlasampannānaṃ sīlasampadaṃ anusikkhati yathārūpānaṃ cāgasampannānaṃ cāgasampadaṃ anusikkhati, yathārūpānaṃ paññāsampannānaṃ paññāsampadaṃ anusikkhati.
an8.54:5.2: idha vyagghapajja, kulaputto āyañca bhogānaṃ viditvā vayañca bhogānaṃ viditvā samaṃ jīvikaṃ kappeti nāccogāḷhaṃ nātihīnaṃ, evaṃ me āyo vayaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassati, na ca me vayo āyaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatīti.
an8.54:5.3: seyyathāpi vyagghapajja, tulādhāro vā tulādhārantevāsī vā tulaṃ paggahetvā jānāti ettakena vā onataṃ ettakena vā unnatanti.
an8.54:5.4: evameva kho vyagghapajja, kulaputto āyañca bhogānaṃ viditvā vayañca bhogānaṃ viditvā samaṃ jīvikaṃ kappeti, na ca accogāḷhaṃ na atihīnaṃ. evaṃ me āyo vayaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassati, na ca me vayo āyaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatīti.
an8.54:5.5: sacāyaṃ vyagghapajja, kulaputto appāyo samāno uḷāraṃ jīvikaṃ kappeti, tassa bhavanti vattāro udumbarakhādikaṃ vāyaṃ kulaputto bhoge bādatī’ti.
an8.54:5.6: sace panāyaṃ vyagghapajja, kulaputto mahāyo samāno kasiraṃ jīvikaṃ kappeti, tassa bhavanti vattāro ‘ajaddhumārikaṃ vāyaṃ kulaputto marissatīti.
an8.54:5.7: yato ca khvāyaṃ vyagghapajja, kulaputto āyañca bhogānaṃ viditvā vayañca bhogānaṃ viditvā samaṃ jīvikaṃ kappeti na accogāḷhaṃ nātihīnaṃ, evaṃ me āyo vayaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassati, na ca me vayo āyaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatī ti.
an8.54:6.1: evaṃ samuppannānaṃ vyagghapajja bhogānaṃ cattāri apāyamukhāni honti:
an8.54:6.2: itthidhutto hoti surādhutto akkhadhutto pāpamitto pāpasahāyo pāpasampavaṅko.
an8.54:6.3: seyyathāpi vyagghapajja, mahato taḷākassa cattāri ceva āyamukhāni. cattāri ca apāyamukhāni,
an8.54:6.4: tassa puriso yāni ceva āyamukhāni tāni pidaheyya, yāni ca apāyamukhāni tāni vivareyya,
an8.54:6.6: evaṃ hi tassa vyagghapajja mahato taḷākassa hāniyeva pāṭikaṅkhā. no vuddhi.
an8.54:6.7: evameva kho vyagghapajja, evaṃ samuppannānaṃ bhogānaṃ cattāri apāyamukhāni honti:
an8.54:6.8: itthidhutto hoti surādhutto akkhadhutto pāpamitto pāpasahāyo pāpasampavaṅko.
an8.54:7.1: evaṃ samuppannānaṃ vyagghapajja, bhogānaṃ cattāri āyamukhāni honti.
an8.54:7.2: na itthidhutto hoti na surādhutto na akkhadhutto kalyāṇamitto kalyāṇasahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅko.
an8.54:7.3: seyyathāpi vyagghapajja, mahato taḷākassa cattāri ceva āyamukhāni cattāri ceva apāyamukhāni,
an8.54:7.4: tassa puriso yāni ceva āyamukhāni tāni vivareyya, yāni ca apāyamukhāni tāni pidaheyya,
an8.54:7.6: evaṃ hi tassa vyagghapajja, mahato taḷākassa vuddhiyeva pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni,
an8.54:7.7: evameva kho vyagghapajja, evaṃ samuppannānaṃ bhogānaṃ cattāri āyamukhāni honti
an8.54:7.8: na itthidhutto hoti, na surādhutto na akkhadhutto kalyāṇamitto kalyāṇasahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅko.
an8.54:8.1: ime kho vyagghapajja, cattāro dhammā kulaputtassa diṭṭhadhammahitāya saṃvattanti, diṭṭhadhammasukhāyāti. cattāro
an8.54:9.1: me vyagghapajja, dhammā kulaputtassa samparāyahitāya saṃvattanti samparāyasukhāya.
an8.54:10.2: idha vyagghapajja, kulaputto saddho hoti saddahati tathāgatassa bodhiṃ:
an8.54:10.3: iti’pi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
an8.54:11.2: idha vyagghapajja kulaputto pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti kāmesumicchācārā paṭivirato hoti musāvādā paṭivirato hoti surāmeraya majjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti,
an8.54:12.2: idha vyagghapajja, kulaputto vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati muttacāgo payatapāṇi vossaggarato yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgarato,
an8.54:13.2: idha vyagghapajja, kulaputto paññavā hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato, ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā,
an8.54:14.1: ime kho vyagghapajja, cattāro dhammā kulaputtassa samparāyahitāya saṃvattanti samparāyasukhāyāti.
